text: i dont see the button/action for bevel, where is it located/what is the keybinding ?
resolution: Confirmed the vertex Bevel action is selection-contextual: it appears for exactly one selected vertex and becomes Weld for a multi-vertex selection. Added the missing live B binding for Bevel in both Vertex and Edge modes; Face B remains Glass and Paint B remains Fill. The 17-command keymap suite and a fresh ReleaseFast editor build pass.
